import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

ref_file = r"C:\Users\sandeeppawar\Downloads\aida-eval\data\file_generation_en\reference\FG_2\simulated_order_data_merged_res.xlsx"
pred_file = r"C:\Users\sandeeppawar\Downloads\aida-eval\runs\aida-ctrl\work\FG_2\simulated_order_data_merged.xlsx"

ref_df = pd.read_excel(ref_file, sheet_name='Merge')
pred_df = pd.read_excel(pred_file, sheet_name='merged')

# Generate sampling indices: head (30) + tail (30) + middle (30) + random (30)
n_sample = 30
total_rows = len(ref_df)

# Head indices
head_indices = list(range(min(n_sample, total_rows)))

# Tail indices
tail_indices = list(range(max(0, total_rows - n_sample), total_rows))

# Middle indices
mid_start = (total_rows // 2) - (n_sample // 2)
mid_end = mid_start + n_sample
middle_indices = list(range(max(0, mid_start), min(total_rows, mid_end)))

# Random indices (but reproducible)
np.random.seed(42)
random_indices = np.random.choice(total_rows, size=min(n_sample, total_rows), replace=False).tolist()

# Combine all indices (remove duplicates)
all_sample_indices = sorted(list(set(head_indices + tail_indices + middle_indices + random_indices)))

print(f"Total sample size: {len(all_sample_indices)} out of {total_rows} rows")

# Compare sampled rows
ref_sample = ref_df.iloc[all_sample_indices].reset_index(drop=True)
pred_sample = pred_df.iloc[all_sample_indices].reset_index(drop=True)

# Direct comparison
are_equal = ref_sample.equals(pred_sample)
print(f"\nDirect equality check on samples: {are_equal}")

if not are_equal:
    # Find differences
    print("\n=== Checking for differences ===")
    for col in ref_sample.columns:
        ref_col = ref_sample[col]
        pred_col = pred_sample[col]
        
        # Handle different types
        if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(ref_col) and pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(pred_col):
            # Numeric comparison with tolerance
            diff_mask = ~np.isclose(ref_col, pred_col, rtol=1e-6, atol=1e-6, equal_nan=True)
            if diff_mask.any():
                print(f"Column '{col}' has {diff_mask.sum()} differences")
        elif pd.api.types.is_datetime64_any_dtype(ref_col) and pd.api.types.is_datetime64_any_dtype(pred_col):
            # Datetime comparison
            diff_mask = ref_col != pred_col
            if diff_mask.any():
                print(f"Column '{col}' has {diff_mask.sum()} differences")
        else:
            # String/object comparison (handle NaN)
            ref_filled = ref_col.fillna('__NULL__')
            pred_filled = pred_col.fillna('__NULL__')
            diff_mask = ref_filled != pred_filled
            if diff_mask.any():
                print(f"Column '{col}' has {diff_mask.sum()} differences")
                # Show first few differences
                diff_indices = diff_mask[diff_mask].index[:3]
                for idx in diff_indices:
                    print(f"  Row {idx}: ref='{ref_col.iloc[idx]}' vs pred='{pred_col.iloc[idx]}'")
else:
    print("All sampled rows match perfectly!")
